name: pmg-keep-decision-log
description: Keeps a product decision log of short dated records (context, decision, status, consequences) and a rule for when a settled decision may be reopened. Use for "run pmg-keep-decision-log", "log this decision", "decision record", "decisions keep getting reopened", "we already decided this", "write up what we decided", "decision history", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
